paragraphs.text: I'm Sam Carter, a Drupal developer who works with organisations and agencies that still run older Drupal sites, and I write because I would like to connect and tell you more about the work that I do for them every single day of the week, all year.
I'm Sam Carter, a Drupal developer. Thanks for connecting.
Drupal 7 stopped getting security updates on 5 January 2025, so new security holes stay open.
Modules no longer get fixes, so small faults pile up.
I can write a free one-page upgrade-risk report for Northfield Museum Trust: what is at risk and what an upgrade involves. It is yours to keep. Reply and I will send it.
